audience: care teams and health-data developers who query patient records in Health Gorilla

useCases.title: Find a patient and read the full record
useCases.text: The AI searches patients by name and date of birth, then reads the comprehensive record of the match. It sums up the main findings.

useCases.title: Review medications, allergies and immunizations
useCases.text: The AI lists the prescriptions, allergies and immunizations of one patient. You get a summary of what is on file.

useCases.title: Look at recent lab results
useCases.text: The AI lists the laboratory observations and diagnostic reports of one patient. It groups the observations by test.

useCases.title: Read the clinical documents of a patient
useCases.text: The AI lists the document references of one patient and opens the content of a chosen document, such as a visit summary.

useCases.title: Retrieve outside records from the national networks
useCases.text: The AI starts a records retrieval for one patient across the connected networks and checks its progress. It asks for your OK first.
